description: Hello, my name is Dava Newman, and I'm a PhD candidate at UC Berkeley. I work in the field of artificial intelligence, and my research focuses on building computer models that can gain knowledge from experience. Recently, I've been working on a project called Testudo, which is a learning robot that uses a photocell to measure its surroundings.
